workingTitle: Webb found an unexpectedly clear sightline through cosmic reionization
topic: Cosmology & Early Universe / Galaxies & Galactic Evolution
coreFacts: JWST/NIRSpec detected flux blueward of Lyman-alpha at about 7 sigma from JADES-GS-z7-LAF at redshift 7.57.
Independent JWST/NIRCam F090W imaging detected the same blueward flux at about 10 sigma.
The favored interpretation is an exceptionally transparent intergalactic sightline during reionization.
The authors found no evidence for a foreground interloper but cannot formally exclude one.
caveats: The work is an unreviewed preprint.
Low spectral resolution cannot establish a continuously transparent path.
The detected non-ionizing ultraviolet flux does not directly measure the escape fraction of ionizing photons.
sourceStatus: Primary preprint and full text verified; no secondary source required.
